messages:
Karthik: heads-up — planning a staggered weighted-shift for EU edge tonight 23:30 UTC. Target: route-policy v3 with weight-sink fallback. Who's available for smoke checks + rollback tap?
Liz: I'm on call — can run smoke probes and quick end-to-end traces. Lower TTLs?
Mike: I can own the rollout. Plan: 10% at 23:30 -> 30% at 23:42 -> 60% at 00:00 -> 100% by 00:30 if green. Rollback trigger = error spike >1% over 5m or median p50 latency +200ms.
Anne: will lower LB DNS TTL to 30s and update runbook. I'll post the runbook link when done.
Devon: I'll prepare the probe job (probe-v2) — it checks 200 synthetic sessions across EU and validates token latency and 5xx rate.
Mike: scheduling note: I'm pushing route-policy v3 using the weighted-sink config. Command I'll use:
```
rbctl routes apply --policy route-policy-v3 --weights eu=10,na=90 --note "staggered-shift"
```
Liz: smoke checklist (I will post results inline):
- 1) synthetic login flows (probe-v2) ✅
- 2) interactive prompt latency spot checks ✅
- 3) KV-cache hit rate sanity ✅
- 4) error-rate histogram (alerts on >1%)
sre-bot: monitor:eu-edge alert rule set to notify #incidents if error_rate > 1% for 5m.
Mike: rollback plan: run `rbctl routes apply --policy route-policy-v2 --weights eu=0,na=100` and revert DNS TTL to previous. I'll keep the rollback command pinned in the thread.
Karthik: cool. Anne, drop the runbook link. Liz/Mike — can you both ack when you're ready? We'll go at 23:30 UTC sharp. :thumbsup:
Liz: ack — ready.
Mike: ack — I'll post each weight step and health counts as we go.
Anne: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-weighted-shift-v3 — updated TTL section.
Devon: probe job prepped and queued, will attach results after first step.
Karthik: thanks all — I'll be available for the 23:30 window. If anything noisy, call out and we'll cut weights immediately.
